boundary_invariants: EQA coordinates and routes; each family retains its domain judgment and owner.
Family outputs need schema, evidence, coverage, status, and release effect before node completion.
Critical blocks cannot be averaged away.
Disagreement and source reports are preserved.
No release without human authorization, fixity/provenance, and receipt.
Post-publication cases remain separate from ordinary pre-publication editing.
